entries.title: Plan B Is Extremely Dangerous: Benjamin Moser on Anti-Zionism
entries.summary: “Israel’s national argument is based on the idea that Israel keeps Jews safe—that we can exist in Sweden or in Holland or in New Jersey only because we have this plan B.”

entries.title: Adelle Waldman Is the 2026–2027 Paris Review Visiting Professor at the Bard Prison Initiative
entries.summary: “In 2024, The Paris Review and BPI announced a partnership, through which a distinguished creative writer would teach the literature that has most inspired them to BPI’s students.”

entries.title: On “Derek,” Captain Ahab’s Evil Half Brother
entries.summary: “Your worst enemy ain’t Moby Dick, it’s your half brother, Derek.”

entries.title: My Larval Roommates
entries.summary: “When holes appeared in my underwear, I knew that I had a case of moths.”
